youtube.title: In This City, Gravity Pulls Toward Granny Marta
youtube.description: An original animated tiny tale: in this city, whatever you let go of falls toward whoever carries the most, so everyone tries to carry nothing. Then the lightest kid floats away. The story is pure fiction – the rules of this city are invented and the characters (Granny Marta, Bo) are made up.

tiktok.caption: In this city, nothing falls down. It falls toward Granny Marta. Who would you want to catch you? (A tiny tale – fiction.)
